accounting.setup_and_runtime_install_cost: Separate from bounded worker; dependency install report/pip freeze and CI timings preserved, not counted as zero.

semantics.source_reference: Exact b3fd BoundaryPopulation and Published implementation; legacy affine fixture matches exact original Gitblob.
semantics.law_profile: Law is installed by Published(Law(...)); basis_y is checked against its scalar law constants. Nonuniform grid, cuts and reset_weights are coherent; reset mean .30 and mass1 within2e-14.
semantics.copy: Complete reference.prices object deep-copied before final state load and cache rebuild; tensors must match reference and must not alias.
semantics.load: Recursive target module post-hook rebuilds derived buffers from actual target Python law and fully loaded tensor state. Bare state_dict cannot transport omitted Python law; only same-law imports are qualified. Different laws require copy_reference with the complete coherent reference.
semantics.unsupported: Arbitrary .data writes, dynamic Python-law reassignment, concurrent mutation, cross-device/dtype moves after cache creation, TorchScript/compile and gradient learning of fixed physical-law buffers are outside this repair qualification. Explicit rebuild after coherent installation or rejection remains required.
semantics.tolerance: F64 absolute2e-11 original affine price gate reused; synthetic selected domain only, not proof of all law/grid values.
semantics.negative_controls: Actual original affine implementation remains frozen and must pass default but fail nondefault law/grid and nested-grid parity by >=1e-5. Same-key poisoned cache is loaded and must be rebuilt, not trusted.
semantics.scientific_claim: Cache state consistency only; no task quality, natural defect repair gain or training speedup claimed.

failure_policy.counts: Started and returned counters recorded before/after each bounded primitive; partial failure counts lower bounds, not zero or refundable.
failure_policy.continuation: Any numerical/source/runtime failure retains results and stops; no new input, tolerance or retry without independent explicit protocol.
failure_policy.wrapper: Create-only output/LAUNCH_ONCE, exact protocol hash, only owned child process group, protected result parse and partial progress read; unknown remains unknown.
